title: Vegetarianism
subtitle: 「素食主義／素食飲食／無肉飲食／不食肉」，究竟是哪一種 vegetarianism？
description: 「素食主義／素食飲食／無肉飲食／不食肉」，究竟是哪一種 vegetarianism？

words.meaning: 不吃肉的飲食方式；無肉飲食
words.note: 使用者提供。這是透明、自然的改寫，強調日常飲食中不吃肉。它比 vegetarianism 少一點身份、理念或生活方式意味，更偏實際 eating pattern。
words.example: The campaign encourages meat-free eating one day a week.

exercises.original: The programme promotes vegetarianism by offering more meat-free meals in schools.
exercises.zh: 該計劃透過在學校提供更多無肉餐，推廣不吃肉的飲食方式。
exercises.upgrade: meat-free eating · 不吃肉的飲食方式；無肉飲食

options.explanation: offering more meat-free meals 聚焦實際吃甚麼，而不是身份或倫理理念。
標準 diet-level 表達，通常排除肉類和魚類。 但本題的具體線索是 a practical pattern of choosing meals without meat；這句真正要表達的是「實際無肉飲食行為」。因此 vegetarian diet 雖然與 vegetarianism 有關，嚴格程度、身份意味、時間尺度或使用語域並不最吻合。

falseSynonyms.zh: vegetarian diet 強調吃甚麼；vegetarianism 還可包括身份、倫理理念或長期生活方式。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She follows a vegetarian diet. Vegetarianism can also be an ethical commitment.

falseSynonyms.zh: meat-free eating 更行為導向，可是暫時或部分實踐，不一定代表 vegetarian identity。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The campaign promotes meat-free eating on Mondays. He identifies strongly with vegetarianism.

falseSynonyms.zh: 兩者不是同義詞。veganism 通常排除所有動物性食品，並可能延伸至其他動物產品；vegetarianism 通常可包含蛋或乳製品。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She is vegetarian and eats cheese. A vegan diet excludes dairy products.

falseSynonyms.zh: plant-based 的實際用法可寬可窄，未必等於嚴格 vegetarian；不能自動互換。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON His diet is mostly plant-based but includes fish occasionally. A vegetarian diet excludes fish.

falseSynonyms.zh: plant-forward eating 更寬鬆，重點是增加植物食物，仍可包含少量肉。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The menu is plant-forward but still includes chicken. The vegetarian menu contains no meat.

falseSynonyms.zh: pescetarianism 通常不吃肉類但會吃魚和海鮮，因此不是 vegetarianism 的精確同義詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A pescetarian may eat fish. A vegetarian normally does not eat fish.

falseSynonyms.zh: meat reduction 只是少吃肉，不要求完全戒肉；vegetarianism 一般要求不吃肉。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The campaign encourages meat reduction. Vegetarianism excludes meat.

falseSynonyms.zh: abstention from meat 只描述不吃肉這一行為，可是暫時、宗教性或節期性的；未必代表完整 vegetarian diet 或 identity。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The festival requires abstention from meat. She has followed vegetarianism for twenty years.
